objective: Expand Step 5 Chinese target-domain supervision with precision-targeted boundary samples for future few-shot adaptation tests.

buckets.review_notes: Boundary expansion: high BGE-M3 semantic similarity plus high structural overlap. Assign positive only if seller-specific evidence or coherent cross-listing behavior supports same-controller identity; otherwise use negative or uncertain.

Boundary expansion: high semantic similarity with strong profile/style divergence and no direct identifier anchor. This is a hard-negative probe for template resale or public-copy reuse; assign negative only when the two sellers appear controller-distinct.

positive: Use positive only when the edge-level evidence supports same-controller identity, not merely shared product topic or public template reuse.
High semantic similarity and structural overlap are triage signals, not labels.
negative: Use negative for high-semantic template-resale or public-copy rows when profile/style/business evidence points to distinct controllers.
Do not mark a row negative just because one side has sparse data; use uncertain when the evidence is insufficient.
uncertain: Use uncertain for strong overlap without enough seller-specific identity evidence.
Use uncertain when the row is plausible same-controller but cannot be defended as a training label.

target_after_review.note: Do not change the frozen benchmark until the boundary expansion queue is human-reviewed and copied back into the active Step 5 queue.

hard_rules: Do not auto-label any selected row.
Select only rows that are pending in the active Step 5 Chinese strict review queue.
Exclude rows already present in active frozen labels.
Keep the active frozen benchmark unchanged until the targeted queue is human-reviewed and explicitly applied back to the active queue.
After applying reviewed labels, rerun Step 5 freeze before rerunning Step 7, Step 9, or Step 11.
